name: Multimedia Design

credential.title: AP degree – academy profession, not a bachelor's

summary: A two-year academy profession (AP) degree in digital design and web development, with technical, creative and communication coursework and an internship in the fourth semester. It is taught in Esbjerg and is shorter than a bachelor's. Needs English B plus Maths or business economics at C level.
description: The four-semester course combines digital content production and digital user interfaces. Projects cover web design, programming and media production, alongside electives, an internship and a final assignment.

structure.teachingStyle: Theory and practical projects, with assignments and presentations from businesses.
structure.placement: An internship in semester four, in Denmark or abroad.
structure.studyAbroad: A semester abroad or an internship abroad is possible.
